rationale: High-contrast is essential for outdoor use under sunlight. The vibrant transport variant uses Nigerian Green and Danfo Yellow to establish local familiarity, trust, and clear visual hierarchy for fast decision-making.

markers.bus: Primary Green circle with white bus icon
markers.danfo: Secondary Yellow circle with black van icon
markers.keke: Dark Gray circle with white tricycle icon

StickyHeader.layout: absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 p-4 pt-12 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E2E8F0]
StickyHeader.elements: Search bar (h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#F1F5F9] px-4) and horizontal scrolling FilterChips.

FilterChip.default: px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-white text-[#64748B] font-medium flex-row items-center gap-2
FilterChip.active: px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-[#008751] bg-[#E6F3EC] text-[#008751] font-bold flex-row items-center gap-2

BottomSheet.layout: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] p-6 pb-8
BottomSheet.handle: w-12 h-1.5 bg-[#E2E8F0] rounded-full mx-auto mb-6

ReportFAB.layout: absolute bottom-6 right-6 w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-[#008751] shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center z-50

RouteCard.layout: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-2xl p-5 mb-4 shadow-sm
RouteCard.header: Flex row, Title (h3) and ETA badge (bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 rounded-md px-2 py-1)
RouteCard.body: Origin to Destination timeline with dashed connecting line.

CrowdIndicator.bars: 3 vertical bars of increasing height. Color changes based on status (Empty=1 green bar, Moderate=2 yellow bars, Packed=3 red bars)

QuickReportGrid.button: h-24 bg-[#F8F9FA] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 active:bg-[#E6F3EC] active:border-[#008751]

motion_and_interactions.bottom_sheet: Spring animation for smooth dragging and snapping.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Opacity feedback on press (active:opacity-70) or scale down (active:scale-95).
motion_and_interactions.map_markers: Pulse animation for live moving vehicles.

onboarding_1.description: Yellow tricycle (Keke) navigating a Lagos street. Use for 'Know your ride' onboarding screen.

onboarding_2.description: Vibrant street scene featuring a yellow danfo bus. Use for 'Crowdsourced updates' onboarding screen.

onboarding_3.description: People waiting at a bus stop. Use for 'Never wait aimlessly' onboarding screen.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over map must use solid background pills. Important ETAs must meet 4.5:1 ratio.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST include testID (React Native equivalent of data-testid).
